key.name: clipboard-clear-seconds
key.description: Seconds after which a copied password, username or code is removed from the clipboard. 0 means never clear.

key.name: lock-enabled
key.description: Require authentication again after the app has been idle for lock-idle-minutes.

key.name: lock-idle-minutes
key.description: Minutes without interaction after which the app locks, when lock-enabled is on.

key.name: hibp-enabled
key.summary: Check passwords against known data leaks
key.description: Query the Have I Been Pwned range API. Only the first 5 hex characters of each password's SHA-1 hash leave the machine.

key.name: favicons-enabled
key.description: Fetch favicons for websites in the list. When off, the app makes no network requests for icons and shows monograms instead.

key.name: sort-order
key.summary: Sort order of the password list
key.description: Sort the list by title, by website, or by last modification time.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in pixels, restored at startup.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in pixels, restored at startup.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when it was last closed.

key.name: generator-mode
key.description: "apple" generates Apple-style strong passwords (xxxxxx-xxxxxx-xxxxxx); "custom" uses the length and character options below.

key.name: generator-length
key.description: Number of characters in custom generated passwords.

key.name: generator-uppercase
key.description: Include uppercase letters in custom generated passwords.

key.name: generator-digits
key.description: Include digits in custom generated passwords.

key.name: generator-symbols
key.description: Include symbols in custom generated passwords.
